name: 結華
text:
いやー、最近の三峰、すごい頑張ってるなー
そんなことをみんなが言ってくれてる気がするなー
trans:
Oh maaan～ That Mitsumine's really been giving it her
all recently! Everyone's been saying as much, I'm
pretty sure.

name: 結華
text:
働き者な三峰にお休みをください……
できたら二週間後がいいなぁ、なーんて……
trans:
Please let poor hard-working Mitsumine have some
time off... If it works for you, two weeks from now
would be great...

name: 結華
text:
さっすが！　プロデューサーは話が分かる男だなぁ
そんじゃよろしくね！　頼みましたよっ
trans:
Just as I hoped! You're the type who gets it,
Producer. Thanks! I'm counting on you.

name: 結華
text:
おっと、ダメか。……ざーんねん
三峰了解いたしましたー
trans:
Uh-oh, I guess not... Oh well.
Mitsumine hears you loud and clear.
